"Code can't be read?# 1. In order to get accurate scanning results, please make sure that the code meets the following characteristics: \u0009\u0009a. rich contrast and not blurry. \u0009\u0009b. no light reflections or shadows on the code. \u0009\u0009c. complete, with no missing parts. 2. If you are using a low-end phone, scanning may be very difficult or even impossible due to the low camera quality. You could try to take a photo with your camera app, then open our app and tap 'Scan from the gallery' to solve this problem. 3. If you still can't get the result when scanning the barcode or QR code, please send an email via %sfeedback%s to us, we will solve the problem for you as soon as possible."
